UniGuid.pk – University Admission & Scholarship Guidance Platform

UniGuid.pk is a centralized web-based platform designed to simplify the university admission process for students across Pakistan. The system provides a single platform where students can search universities, compare programs, explore scholarships, check admission eligibility, and apply for admissions.
Unlike traditional university websites, UniGuid.pk acts as a bridge between students and universities by centralizing admission-related information.
The system supports two admission models:
Students submit applications directly through UniGuid.pk.
Applications are securely transferred to the university through API integration.
redirects the student to the university's official admission portal.

The system has four primary users.
Guest users cannot submit applications until they register.
Partner university APIs depend on university approval.
Only verified universities can become partner universities.
Official university information must be updated regularly.
